visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: Front, top and iso inspected. One tile 33.50 mm square carrying a smooth circular landing pad sunk into a ring of scattered flat-topped boulders. The top view shows the pad as a clean circle with the rubble confined to the perimeter and none of it encroaching on the disc a piece stands on; the front view shows the boulders standing proud of the slab with irregular heights and no spire; the iso shows the rubble as discrete disjoint rocks rather than a fused mat, which is what this part was corrected to be. No misplaced, missing or extra geometry and no visible intersections. Untouched by this revision and byte-identical to the published set's.
